_comment: Token cards defined by the RULEBOOK (rule 187) but absent from
data/cards.json, which ships only the Recruit and Sprite printings.
Every field below is transcribed from data/rules.txt 187.1-187.11 -- none
of it is invented. Kept in a separate file so cards.json can be
regenerated from its upstream source without losing these.
Tokens are never in a decklist (185.3 / 186: they are created on the board
and cease to exist anywhere else), so these exist purely so that a card
saying 'play a 3 Might Mech unit token' has something to instantiate.
Without them nine cards in the deck corpus could not be encoded at all.

The Gold gear token is NOT here: cards.json already ships it as 'Gold // Buff'. An earlier scan filtered to Units and missed it, which would have created a duplicate the engine could pick either half of.

cards.name: Sand Soldier
cards._rule: 187.3 -- a 2 [M] Sand Soldier token is a domainless unit token with 2 Might and the Shurima tag.

cards.name: Mech
cards._rule: 187.4 -- a 3 [M] Mech token is a domainless unit token with 3 Might and the Mech tag.

cards.name: Reflection
cards._rule: 187.6 -- a 0 [M] Reflection token is a domainless unit token with 0 Might.

cards.name: Bird
cards.text: [Deflect] (Opponents must pay {any rune} to choose me with a spell or ability.)
cards._rule: 187.7 -- a 1 [M] Bird token is a domainless unit token with 1 Might, the Bird tag, and the Deflect keyword.

cards.name: Tentacle
cards._rule: 187.10 -- a 1 [M] Tentacle token is a domainless unit token with 1 Might and the Bilgewater tag.

cards.name: Shadow Clone
cards.text: When I attack, you may banish a unit from your trash. If you do, give me [Assault 4] this turn.
cards._rule: 187.11 -- a 0 [M] Shadow Clone token is a domainless unit token with 0 Might and that ability.

cards.name: Brush
cards.text: Bird, Cat, Dog, Poro, and Ivern units here have +1 Might. When you score here, you may replace this with the battlefield it replaced.

cards.name: Baron Pit
cards.text: Units can move here from anywhere.
